headline: Nigerian Exchange Suspends Trading in Coronation Insurance Shares
summary: The Nigerian Exchange Limited suspended trading in Coronation Insurance Plc shares ahead of the company's voluntary delisting from the exchange.
why: Stock exchange trading suspensions precede corporate restructurings, mergers, or complete voluntary de-registrations from public equity markets.
